camera.note: A gentle vertical arc accompanies the 360-degree orbit; camera looks towards the staged model and table.

motion: Exact crank-rocker closure; all gear/crank/rod/rocker/pick motions driven from one input phase. Rigid kinematic depiction, not physical proof.

background.table: Procedurally modelled Louis XV-style walnut, marquetry and ormolu table; cabriole legs and rocaille apron
background.room: Unoccupied Parisian-inspired photography studio, French windows, cream mouldings, chevron parquet and a single white paper sweep

lighting: Warm side key, cool low fill, warm rim; local indirect-light bake, captured room reflections and screen-space ray tracing; subtle visual edge bevels do not change the CAD.
endpoint_sampling: 5760 uniformly spaced samples including both0 and480 seconds; final camera and mechanism pose reset exactly to the opening pose.
